summary: The customer asked for their active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness to be cancelled so no future collections could be taken. The desk could not submit the request or ask the recurring system, because the customer's verification was not established and no confirmation of the cancellation had been given, so it escalated the case and cancelled nothing. A person still needs to verify the customer and get their confirmation (for example in the secure portal) before the cancellation goes to the Direct Debit team.
